استخرجت (form X)
# اِسْتَخْرَجْتُ (istaḵrajtu) /is.tax.rad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرَجْتَ (istaḵrajta) /is.tax.rad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرَجْتِ (istaḵrajti) /is.tax.rad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَخْرَجَ (istaḵraja)
# اِسْتَخْرَجَتْ (istaḵrajat)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
